record.original_question: Let G be a simple Eulerian graph, meaning every vertex of G has even degree. Let cd(G) denote the smallest number of edge-disjoint circuits whose union is the entire edge set E(G). Is it always true that cd(G) ≤ |V(G)|/2 for every simple Eulerian graph G?

evidence.quote: for every simple eulerian graph G.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A graph $G$ is called Eulerian if every vertex of $G$ has even degree. A circuit in $G$ is a connected subgraph in which every vertex has even degree (equivalently, an edge-disjoint union of simple cycles that is connected), and a circuit decomposition of $G$ is a partition of the edge set $E(G)$ into edge-disjoint circuits. For a simple Eulerian graph $G$, let $\mathrm{cd}(G)$ denote the minimum number of circuits in any circuit decomposition of $E(G)$.

Prove or disprove: for every simple Eulerian graph $G$,
$$\mathrm{cd}(G) \le \frac{|V(G)|}{2}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: Hajós' conjecture, that every simple Eulerian graph on n vertices admits a decomposition into at most ⌊n/2⌋ circuits, remains open in general. It has been verified for several restricted classes (e.g., projective-planar graphs, K6−-minor free graphs, graphs with maximum degree at most 4, pathwidth ≤ 6) and computationally for all Eulerian graphs with up to 12 vertices, but no general proof or counterexample is known.

status_evidence.title: Hajós' cycle conjecture for small graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Hajós' conjecture has been verified for all Eulerian graphs with up to twelve nodes.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is verified computationally for small graphs but remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Cycle decompositions of pathwidth-6 graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Hajós' conjecture is satisfied for graphs of pathwidth at most 6.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for restricted graph classes; the general conjecture is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Hajós' conjecture and projective graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Hajós' conjecture is true for projective graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Confirmed for projective-planar graphs only; general case open.
